git diff --check && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
paths = [Path('docs/runbooks/receipts-stopped.md'), Path('docs/runbooks/README.md'), Path('docs/architecture.md')]
for path in paths:
    text = path.read_text()
    assert '[[fill:' not in text, path
    for link in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)', text):
        assert (path.parent / link.split('#')[0]).exists(), (path, link)
runbook = paths[0].read_text()
assert re.findall(r'^## (.+)$', runbook, re.M) == ['Before you begin', 'Steps', 'If it fails']
print('Checked local links, runbook sections, placeholders, and diff whitespace.')
PY
